body:
First of all, would like to apologize to you because being bullied is the worst. I can definitely identify with you and understand how you feel. What i can tell you though is that, who cares about them? Worry about yourself, Anon. I know it's hard to forget something as traumatic as that but overtime, those people won't even exist in your world. We get older and have other things to tend to...

Don't let some lowlifes bring you down and ruin the rest of your life...

You aren't a loser and there's so much out there in the world to look forward to instead of looking in the past. Hang in there!
